title: Interest in jazz since the 1930s; Dixieland and swing
summary: He thinks interest in jazz continued through the 1930s despite derivatives like swing; today's Dixieland is a version of New Orleans jazz. He likens himself to an onlooker unfamiliar with animal husbandry.
